contract: docs/swarm-integration.plan.md: preserve original portfolio, opt-in independent decoration; original DOM interactive; see docs/swarm-validation.md for limits

accessibility.evidence: New decoration only: canvas aria-hidden, native stop button min-height 44px and visible focus style. Enter on focused stop button and Escape stop session in real browser. Reduced-motion blocks automatic start; explicit native Play button was clicked in Ego under unchanged reduced preference and started the effect. Escape stops. Form remains editable. This is not a whole-page WCAG audit.

responsive.evidence: Captured both targets with active effect. Heading/portrait/project rectangles identical to opt-out measurements; no added horizontal overflow. Narrow view tested with fine pointer; actual coarse input is intentionally disabled.

loading.reason: Local deferred synchronous script; no async animation assets or loading UI. Page never hidden.

empty.evidence: Idle agents orbit without needing tasks; real content is not removed. Tests advance beyond all completed tasks.

error.evidence: Unit test verifies absent 2D context returns inactive without inserting any overlay; exceptions have cleanup but exception branches remain unforced.

partial.reason: No snapshot, cloned content or capture of remote media; animation draws geometric decorations over real content.

success.evidence: Opt-in active screenshots; Escape and Enter on stop button remove layer. Interaction JSON confirms active false on stop.

permission.reason: Independent code with no upstream assets, permission prompts, privileged APIs or data transmission.

renderedEvidence.observation: Original narrow portfolio preserved; optional transparent cursors and stop control visible. Compared measured layout against baseline.
Original desktop hero, portrait, navigation and lilac styling preserved; cursors and top edge tracing visible without covering content.
